historical_references.reference: Historical records show that The Rise and Fall of the Western Sudanic Empire The name Ravoof carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Rab-ul-'Uf, also known as Ravoof or Rufisque, was the capital city of the Mali Empire, one of the largest and most powerful Western Sudanic empires. Under the reign of Mansa Musa, the empire reached its height, with control over vast territories in present-day Mauritania, Mali, Senegal, and Guinea. Rab-ul-'Uf was an important center for trade, with links to the Mediterranean, the Sahara, and the Atlantic coast.
